description.en: A coastal motorway of approximately 103 km between the Black Sea cities of Varna and Burgas, on Pan-European Corridor VIII, estimated to cost €307 million. As of 2016 only the first 10 km, Varna to Priseltsi, had been built; the remaining 93 km is still at the planning stage.

note.en: The 10 km from the Asparuhov Bridge to before Priseltsi was completed by 1980 (no exact year given), per Profit.bg.
note.ro: Cei 10 km de la Podul Asparuhov până înainte de Priseltsi au fost finalizați până în 1980 (fără an exact), potrivit Profit.bg.

sources.title: Profit.bg: Магистралите в България - А4 „Черно море“ (2024-01-23)
